properties.NAME: Disputed Area
properties.CHANGE: The United States claimed the area south of 31 degrees north latitude between the Mississippi and Perdido Rivers, based on its purchase of Louisiana. The U.S. and Spanish West Florida both claimed the area, but Spain actually governed it.
properties.CITATION: (U.S. Stat, vol. 2, ch. 38 [1804], sec. 1/p. 283; Van Zandt, 107)
